description.value: Quick Shuttle runs daily cross-border coach service between Vancouver and Seattle year-round, with stops including Waterfront Station, Canada Place, River Rock Casino, and Surrey on the Canadian side, and SeaTac Airport, the piers, and downtown Seattle on the US side. Bikes travel as an optional 'Extra Bike or Sporting Equipment' item, $42 USD each, selected at booking. They must be securely wrapped, max 70 lbs, and travel space permitting. Call 1-800-665-2122 to confirm space and current pricing.

Bike fee applies.detail: $42 USD per bike, selected at booking

wow_evidence: Scheduled cross-border coach between Vancouver and the US border on the Seattle corridor
